findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess with shell=True
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True can be dangerous if input is not properly sanitized
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-shell-true
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe subprocess or system call that could execute commands."
findings.hypothesis: Check for subprocess calls with shell=True that could be vulnerable to command injection from user-controlled input

message.text: Potentially unsafe subprocess or system call that could execute commands.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-eval
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution operation using eval/exec/compile."
findings.hypothesis: Check for code injection via eval/exec with potentially untrusted input

message.text: Potentially unsafe code execution operation using eval/exec/compile.
